verdict.rationale: The only bulk-style capability in the evidence is a user report of exporting all logged requests at once (comm-7). It is supported by a request query REST endpoint and HQL for retrieving many requests (docs-32, docs-33), but that is bulk read and export only, with no documented bulk mutation actions. Missing for 10: first-party docs on bulk actions (bulk tag, delete, score or re-run across many items), any API for batch updates, and independent hands-on corroboration beyond a single export comment.
